name: Privi Ledger
tagline: The records your company has to keep, sealed so nobody can rewrite them.
intro: Publish a trust page for buyers, run an incident against its legal deadlines, collect policy sign-offs, keep controls current and seal software releases. Documents stay on your device; only their fingerprints are recorded.

key.label: Organization API key
key.help: Your Privi Ledger organization key. It is kept in this browser only and sent to Privi Ledger with each request.
key.skip_pay: Organizations on the Pro plan use every feature without paying per use.

plan_note: Organizations on the Pro plan are not charged per use

features.title: Trust Page
features.blurb: A public page of your claims and evidence to share with buyers.

features.title: Incident Clock
features.blurb: Open an incident and track the notification deadlines.

features.title: Policy Sign-off
features.blurb: Who accepted which version of a policy, and who is missing.

features.title: Control Calendar
features.blurb: Recurring controls, their evidence, and what is overdue.

features.title: Release Seal
features.blurb: Seal a software release; anyone can check a download.
